title: CVDocument, schema version 1
description: A CV as the CVPDFExporter package reads it: version 1 of CVDocument, the exporter's published input (ADR 0002). Unknown properties are ignored by the exporter, so this schema permits them, and an optional field may be absent or null. The schema judges a parsed JSON value and does not express every rule: the exporter's validator also refuses text over 16,384 UTF-8 bytes, control characters other than the line feed, bidirectional embeddings, overrides and isolates, a blank name, a period that ends before it starts, and a document that is too large. The validator is authoritative.
$comment: CVDocumentModelTests holds this schema and the Swift model to each other. The constants of CVDocumentValidator are 16,384 UTF-8 bytes per text, 262,144 for all the text of a document, 200 sections and 200 items per section, and 1,048,576 bytes of JSON. maxLength counts characters, which are never more than UTF-8 bytes, so it never refuses a document the validator accepts. The validator refuses control characters other than the line feed and U+202A to U+202E and U+2066 to U+2069, a name that is empty once whitespace is trimmed (minLength 1 expresses the empty case only), and a period that ends before it starts. What parsing does belongs to the exporter: with duplicate keys Swift's decoder keeps the first value and most others the last; a trailing comma and a leading byte order mark are accepted; UTF-16 and UTF-32 input are accepted too, and the 1,048,576-byte limit then counts bytes in that encoding; nesting deeper than 512 levels is refused; a lone surrogate escape and a number out of range (1e400) are refused in the fields the exporter reads and accepted in the value of an unknown property (a lone surrogate in a property name is refused too); numbers with more than 15 significant digits are rounded as a double is.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema. Any other version is rejected.

language.description: The language of the document as a BCP 47 tag, for example it or en-GB.

sections.description: The sections in print order. At most 200.

optionalText.description: Absent or null when there is no value.

month.description: Absent or null for a date with year precision.

date.description: A date with year or month precision. The renderer formats it in the language of the document.

end.description: present: it goes on. unspecified: it ended on an unknown date. date: it ended on endDate.

oneOf.description: endDate is read only when end is date, and must not be before start.

optionalPeriod.description: Absent or null when there is no period.

name.description: Required and not blank: the validator refuses a name that is empty once whitespace and newlines are trimmed. minLength expresses the empty case only.

section.description: A section is identified by its kind, never by a title. A summary carries text; every other kind carries at most 200 items.

rating.description: Absent or null when the skill is not rated.
